verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is fundamentally a documented, typed Python API/SDK (Agent class, tools, output_type, message history, MCP client) with extensive docs and even an llms.txt for AI-agent consumption, plus a CLI and to_cli_sync() hook for programmatic driving. Community evidence confirms production usage building on top of this API, though some report friction with specific provider integrations rather than the API's documentation itself.
